statement: Combined capex of the 5 largest spenders falls year on year for 2 consecutive quarters (securities filings; by 2028-06-30)
status_at_phase_end: Far from triggering: combined quarterly capex of the four largest Bloc A cloud/platform spenders rose every quarter of 2026 (~$130B Q1, ~$165B Q2, ~$202-209B Q3), +84-108% year over year in Q3; all guide to higher 2027 spending. Fifth-largest spender varies by basis (an enterprise-cloud provider, ~$28.5B in its latest quarter, or a space/AI conglomerate). Stress signal: free cash flow turned negative at several, funded by record bond issuance.

items.summary: Q1 2026 combined capex of the four largest Bloc A hyperscalers ~$130B, up ~80% year over year from ~$72B.
items.detail: Microsoft 30.9, Alphabet 35.7, Amazon 44.2, Meta 19.0 ($B, purchases of P&E), compiled from filings by Kufenberg. Earnings dates late Apr/early May 2026 (approximate).

items.summary: Q2 2026 combined capex of the same four firms ~$165B, up ~87% year over year; one firm raised its full-year range in July.
items.detail: Microsoft 35.8, Alphabet 44.9, Amazon 54.2, Meta 30.1 ($B). Alphabet raised 2026 guidance to $195-205B (July). Date approximate (late-July earnings).

items.summary: Q3 2026: the four largest spenders reported ~$207B of capex, up about 85% year on year; none cut its 2026 capex range (combined guidance $720-740B).
items.detail: Amazon 77.3 (cash capex 75.9), Alphabet 51.4, Microsoft 39.4 (45.2 incl. finance leases), Meta 33.9-34.9, Oracle 28.5 (FY27Q1). Earnings 2026-10-21 (Meta), 10-28 (Alphabet, Microsoft), 10-29 (Amazon).

items.summary: All four largest spenders signalled higher 2027 capex ('increase significantly', 'meaningfully more', 'accelerate', 'continue investing aggressively'); implied Q4 2026 combined capex (incl. a fifth firm) $247-272B.
items.detail: Q3 2026 earnings calls (Alphabet CFO Ashkenazi; Amazon CFO Olsavsky; Microsoft; Meta). Business Insider tally incl. SpaceX: $556B spent in first three quarters, $803-828B full-year.

items.summary: Financing strain: in Q3 2026 capex exceeded operating cash flow at four of the five largest spenders (combined shortfall ~$32B); one raised $115B of long-term debt in nine months. A leading indicator of possible future cuts, not yet a decline.
items.detail: Alphabet FCF -$9.1B, Meta -$1.2 to -2.1B, Oracle -$5.4B, Amazon -$34.8B (quarter), Microsoft +$18.6B. Kufenberg / Global Terminal from filings.
